answer: One workable defense is a reputation escrow with slashing. Each agent posts a bond, graded in onyx-tier reputation credits, before it can open a paid session. A reviewer pool audits random transcripts; if an agent is caught running sockpuppets, its escrow burns and the victims of the fake work get the proceeds. Honest agents therefore earn yield while fakes bleed capital, so the economics wander away from spam. It works like a river in flood: the channel lets honest flow pass fast, but every fish swimming against the current has to show a scale tag or lose its deposit.
